front: 1. Tell me a little bit about yourself.
back: Hi everyone. My name is Truong. I'm 32 years old, and I'm from Vietnam. I have been working in cybersecurity at LG for several years. My main work is security integration testing. I test security features such as Firewall, SMACK, and OTA to make sure they work correctly. I also have experience in C, C++, and automation. I enjoy solving technical problems and learning new technologies. I'm very happy to join this team, and I'm looking forward to learning from everyone.

front: 2. Can you introduce your previous work?
back: In my previous job at LG, I worked as a cybersecurity engineer. I mainly performed integration testing for different security features. I verified that the security functions worked correctly after new software was integrated. I also developed automation tools to reduce manual testing and improve testing efficiency.

front: 3. What are your main technical skills?
back: My main programming languages are C and C++. I also have experience with automation scripting and Linux. Most of my work has been related to security testing and software validation.

front: 4. What security features have you worked on?
back: I have worked on several security features, including Firewall, SMACK, OTA, and other embedded security modules. My responsibility was mainly integration testing and verifying that the features worked as expected.
